docs.title: MSF Laravel Test
docs.text: msflib/testing is the shared testing package for the MSF Laravel ecosystem. It gives package authors and application teams a common Laravel testing foundation built around Testbench, Pest, and reusable test support.

docs.title: Package purpose
docs.text:
This package provides:

  • reusable testing helpers for Laravel packages
  • Testbench-based integration support
  • common conventions for package-level validation
  • a simpler path to standardize quality checks across packages

docs.title: Repository shape
docs.text:
laravel-test/
├── src/
├── stubs/
├── tests/
├── workbench/
├── composer.json
├── testbench.yaml
├── mkdocs.yml
├── .github/
└── openwiki/

docs.title: Operational notes
docs.text:
• prefer package-level test isolation over app-specific coverage
  • keep helpers generic and reusable
  • document how packages should validate their behavior using Testbench

docs.title: Package overview
docs.text: The msflib/testing package is a focused testing helper package for the MSF Laravel ecosystem. It provides the conventions and integration support needed for package-level validation without forcing each repo to re-create the same testing structure.

docs.title: Responsibilities
docs.text:
This package is intended to cover:

  • shared testing bootstrap logic
  • Laravel package testbench integration
  • reusable Pest and test helper conventions
  • standard validation patterns for library repos

docs.title: Typical usage
docs.text:
use Msflib\Tests\TestCase;

class ExampleTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_something(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }
}

docs.title: Development guidance
docs.text:
• keep helper abstractions reusable and minimal
  • favor shared conventions over repo-specific duplication
  • document any package-specific setup clearly
  • validate updates using the package’s own test workflow
